title: CHANGELOG.md and the version-to-changelog check
goal: Every package version has a changelog entry, enforced in CI
acceptance: tools/check-changelog.mjs with a test (tools/check-changelog.test.mjs, `npm run test:tools`); npm run check:changelog in CI and check:fast
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no consuming project's real data, secrets or tokens in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Done 2026-11-25 in one PR; verification is its CI. No actual: the step's start time was not recorded.
